# Regression Tests

Tests for specific bug fixes.

Each test should reference the issue number it addresses:

```markdown
### regression for issue #123

> Description of the bug that was fixed.

```ds
// code that used to fail
```
```

When adding a regression test:
1. Name it clearly with the issue number
2. Include a description of what was wrong
3. Show the code that triggered the bug
4. Verify the expected behavior
